< Dissolve: A film editing technique where one scene gradually overlaps another on the same screen as transition occurs. >

Song Hyunsoo, an unknown actor who makes a living as a bartender.
He gets cast in a famous director’s film and ends up acting alongside the nation’s famous actor, Yoon Juho.

He drinks only water that costs 400,000 won.
He replaces managers as casually as eating a meal.
—Yoon Juho, a man surrounded by countless rumors.

“Where do you live?”
“It’s okay. I can take the bus.”
“I asked where you live. I didn’t say I’d take you home.”
“…Bogwang-dong.”
“I will take you there.”

Though his words are mean, Hyunsoo becomes curious about the unexpectedly gentle side hidden in his past,
and a strange tension begins to form between the two.

“I fail to live up to expectations, leave people alone, hurt them… and every moment I’m reminded that I’m a defective product who only looks fine on the outside. When it comes to relationships, those are the only memories I have.”

But it doesn’t seem easy to conquer a prince who has lived his entire life as a top star…

The past he never even properly began to face fades away, and a new love approaches.
Change and growth to create a final love—and the final choice.
